name: Handelsregister (handelsregister.ai)
description: Access the German commercial register (Handelsregister) through handelsregister.ai: search and filter companies, fetch a company's register data with optional financials, management and shareholders, and download official register documents.
instructions:
This connector uses the handelsregister.ai REST API (https://handelsregister.ai/api/v1), which wraps the official Handelsregister and adds structured data.

**Authentication**: the API key goes in the `x-api-key` header. Create it in the handelsregister.ai dashboard.

**Typical workflow**:
1. `hr_search_companies`: find companies by name, register number or filters. Each hit has an `entity_id`.
2. `hr_get_company`: the full profile. Pass the `entity_id` as `company_id` (names are not unique). Add `features` only when the user needs them, because each one costs credits.
3. `hr_get_shareholders`: the current shareholders (feature `shareholders`).
4. `hr_fetch_document`: one official document (current or chronological excerpt, shareholder list, articles of association, structured XML).

**Credits**: a search costs 1 credit. `hr_get_company` costs 5 credits plus each feature that returns data (financial_kpi 1, related_persons 2, publications 1, shareholders 5, news 10, insolvency_publications 5, annual_financial_statements 5). A document costs 15 credits and is limited to 5 per minute. Failed requests cost nothing.

**Errors**: 404 on a document means the company has no document of that type. 504 means the register did not answer in time: wait at least 60 seconds before trying again. 422 means a parameter value is invalid.

tools.name: hr_search_companies
tools.description: Search German companies in the Handelsregister by name, register number or keyword, optionally with filters (city, legal form, register court, status, industry, revenue...). Returns up to 30 hits per page, each with an entity_id to use as company_id in hr_get_company and hr_fetch_document. Costs 1 credit.

q.description: Search term, 2 to 500 characters: company name, register number (e.g. 'HRB 12345') or keyword. Optional when filters is set.

filters.description: Optional filters as a JSON object string, e.g. {"city":"München","legal_form_code":"GmbH","active":true} or {"registration_type":"HRB","registration_authority_name":"Freiburg"}. Other keys: postal_code, state, status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED, DISSOLVED, INSOLVENT), industry_code, company_size_category (micro, small, medium, large), registration_date_from/to (YYYY-MM-DD); revenue and balance-sheet ranges nest under financial_filters, e.g. {"financial_filters":{"pl_revenue":{"gte":1000000}}}.

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for the next page (default 0).

sort.description: Sort field: relevance (default), registration_date, revenue, employees, equity, share_capital, last_activity, and others from the API docs.

tools.name: hr_get_company
tools.description: Fetch the full register profile of one German company: name, status, legal form, register court and number, address, purpose, registration date. Optional features add financials, management, publications and more, each for extra credits. Base price 5 credits.

company_id.description: The entity_id from hr_search_companies (most reliable). A company name or register number also works, but names are not unique.

features.description: Optional comma-separated extra data, only what the user needs: financial_kpi, balance_sheet_accounts, profit_and_loss_account, related_persons (management), publications, news, insolvency_publications, annual_financial_statements, shareholders, ubos, shareholdings. Example: 'financial_kpi,related_persons'.

financial_statement_type.description: For financial features: auto (default), annual (single-entity Jahresabschluss) or consolidated (group).

financial_years.description: For financial features: only the N newest fiscal years.

tools.name: hr_get_shareholders
tools.description: The current shareholders of a German company, with the company's register profile. Costs 5 credits plus 5 for the shareholders when data is returned.

company_id.description: The entity_id from hr_search_companies (most reliable), or a company name or register number.

tools.name: hr_fetch_document
tools.description: Download one official document from the commercial register: AD (current excerpt), CD (chronological excerpt), shareholders_list, articles_of_association (PDF) or SI (structured register content, XML). Costs 15 credits, at most 5 per minute. A 404 means the company has no document of that type.

document_type.description: AD = current register excerpt, CD = chronological excerpt, SI = structured content (XML), shareholders_list, articles_of_association.
